topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Of course, you're welcome to use part of the yard for your garden. I imagine the rows of fresh vegetables and herbs, the way they'll catch the morning light. It's a joy to think of you tending to the soil, your hands turning the earth, nurturing something so vibrant and alive. I can almost see the bees already, buzzing from flower to flower, and the way the leaves will glisten after a gentle rain. It's a gift to share this space, to see it come alive with your touch. If you need any tools or help, you just let me know.
